other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage via Early Stopping
other_failure_modes.description: The validation set used to evaluate the model's out-of-fold performance is also passed as the evaluation set for early stopping. This can lead to an overoptimistic validation score because the number of trees is tuned on the same data used for evaluation.

summary: The solution implements a reasonable XGBoost baseline with domain-informed feature engineering and cross-validation. However, it suffers from data leakage by computing frequency encodings across the combined train and test sets, and by using a random split on temporal data. Furthermore, the agent relies entirely on the model to handle missing values without explicit cleaning and utilizes naive unweighted ensembling.
